description: Search X as its own search box does, newest first, about 20 a page; X's search operators work inside `query` (`from:nasa`, `since:2026-09-01`, `lang:en`). `type=user` finds accounts instead. Use this to follow a topic, a brand or a campaign. Costs 13 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

query.description: Words, a phrase, or X's search operators.
